name: Counterweight lift
description: A lift gate raised by a counterweight: put enough weight on the plate (a crate, a statue, a companion) and the gate rises; take it off and the gate falls. The plate's window is the counterweight, so too little keeps it shut and, with a ceiling, too much does too.

counterweight.description: Weight on the plate that raises the lift.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: Anything resting on the plate counts by its weight.

outputs.name: raised
outputs.description: On while the lift gate is raised.
